title: typha angustifolia subsp. javanica
intro: Typha angustifolia subsp. javanica, commonly known as the Javan bulrush or cattail, is a plant species belonging to the Typhaceae family. It is widely used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Javan bulrush include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
